description: Refers loading zone pilot update to Accessibility Committee.

chips.text: Accessibility Advisory Committee reviews pilot's impact on disabled residents.

description: City establishes process for accessible loading zone requests.
New policy sets eligibility and design standards.
Zones for schools, health facilities, civic, community uses.

chips.text: Received as information
Policy does not yet address snow removal for accessible loading zones.
Pilot participants and users expressed high satisfaction and support for zones.
Improves access to buildings for people using mobility devices.

description: Saskatoon may increase accessible loading zones beyond 2% target.

chips.text: Councillor questions 2% accessible parking target, suggests 4-5% may be needed.
Residents with mobility issues and their caregivers are affected.
Staff will revisit 2% accessible parking target if user needs are not met.

description: Increases on-street accessible parking in pay zones.
Sets design standards and location criteria for new spaces.
Prioritizes snow removal for accessible parking and ramps.
Committee seeks more feedback for a March review.

chips.text: Approved
Committee found the proposed 2% cap on Broadway insufficient.
Out-of-town visitors and regional users of city services.
Data on local accessible parking placard usage is not yet available.
Public speaker expressed strong support for accessible loading zones.
Accessible parking demand may be higher than the 2% proposed cap.
Staff committed to revisiting the 2% accessible parking cap.

description: Set 2026 Work Plan categories for transit, accessibility, safety, education.

chips.text: Approved
Work plan includes focus on transit access for deafblind individuals.

description: Committee will form ad hoc subcommittees as needed.

chips.text: Approved
Subcommittee activity was limited in the previous year with few meetings held.

description: Council reviews current statement of expenditures.

chips.text: Received as information
Discussion confirmed the budget is automatically added each year.
